Kuvitus: luokan lattialla rata, jolla le: Illustration: a track on a classroom floor along which a toy car runs beside a tape measure. A group stands on each side of the track, and each group has its own stopwatch; the hands of the watches have stopped at different places.
Kuvaaja suhteellisesta epävarmuudesta aj: Graph of relative uncertainty as a function of time when the uncertainty of the time is 0.2 s: at a time of 1 s the uncertainty is 20 %, at 4 s it is 5.0 %, and at 10 s it is 2.0 %. The green region shows measurements whose uncertainty is at most 5.0 %: they require a time of at least 4 s. The graph is drawn to scale.
Kuvitus: kuula vierii kirjapinon varaan: Illustration: a ball rolls down a wooden ramp resting on a stack of books, and faint copies show its earlier positions. A stopwatch is at the top right.
Kaavakuva kokeen asetelmasta: paristokäy: Diagram of the experimental set-up: a battery toy car runs on a table from a start line to a finish line with a chequered flag. A tape measure with a scale in metres runs along the edge of the table, and the gap between the start line and the finish line is the independent variable, the distance s. A stopwatch measures the time t, which is the dependent variable. The car, the surface and the batteries are kept constant. The scale is accurate: 150 units in the picture correspond to one metre.
Illustration: a wooden ramp rests on a stack of books. At the top of the ramp a light orange plastic ball waits behind an upright ruler, and at the bottom of the ramp there is a blue finish line, a small blue flag and a wooden stopper. A heavy steel ball waits its turn on the table beside the ramp. A stopwatch is at the top right.
